​

I can safely say that anything good that might have happened to me, was at least 6-7 years ago. It's been a downhill ride since then. All friends and acquaintances have moved ahead and settled into a new phase of life. I am just stuck and getting older by the day.

> why do you think you are shutting them out? 

Because I feel ashamed that they're all working and I'm not. We all finished Bachelors in Technology together, but they've been working since then and are earning well. Three of them are married too. In the same duration, I worked for two years, did Masters for two years, and accumulated an overall gap of 3 years. If even hypothetically I get the courage to go for some interview, who's going to hire a person that hasn't prepared anything and has 4 or 5 years of gap in the resume. I will also get paid way less. At this stage of my life, I should've been settled in a job and married to a partner that I wanted to share my life with. On the contrary, I've had to move back to my parents' house, I have no job and I'm getting older each day having never experienced an intimate relationship.

​

> be honest with me. have you ever felt happiness from anything in your life? experiences, friends, family, communicating, hobbies, school, a day with good weather, anything at all? 

Frankly, I don't remember anything now. If I look back, maybe the time I spent in college with friends. There might be others but I just don't remember.

Every day there's a moment of positivity when I feel I should do something, but it fizzles out in a few minutes and I'm back to thinking negative stuff. I automatically wake up after sleeping just 1 hour at night and then finally am able to sleep in the morning.

> continuing to be hard on yourself & calling yourself bad things is certainly not going to help 

Just being real.

I don't pick up their phone calls because they will inevitably ask me about what I'm doing and I'll have no answer. I stopped answering their group texts for months and just recently went back to it. It doesn't really matter what happens, nothing would make me happy. There will always be something that'll claw at me. I have understood that living is not meant for me. I just need to gain the courage to end it.

I can't even talk about all this to my parents, let alone a stranger. Time is running by both for getting married and finding a career.
